video_title: How my AAU team is helping me train for my comeback season

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on the importance of player development in AAU
quotes.excerpt: Each one of them be at their best, wins and losses you can't control
quotes.quote: Each one of them be at their best, wins and losses you can't control as much as you can control your attitude being right, you being in shape.

quotes.speaker: Josh Russell
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Russell on the importance of AAU live periods for recruiting
quotes.excerpt: You want the kids to be as best prepared for July as possible.
quotes.quote: You want the kids to be as best prepared for July as possible. Be in shape, be at their best.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on the difference between AAU and NBA training
quotes.excerpt: The NBA is the next, next level.
quotes.quote: The NBA is the next, next level. You don't do that in the NBA because you're already there.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on the goal of his AAU program
quotes.excerpt: The most important thing for me is like kids to go to school for free.
quotes.quote: The most important thing for me is like kids to go to school for free. I want kids to be able to use basketball as a vehicle for the rest of their lives. Our goal in our program is to get scholarships to go to college.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on the unpredictability of college recruiting
quotes.excerpt: You never know who's watching. You never know when somebody's going to come to the game
quotes.quote: You never know who's watching. You never know when somebody's going to come to the game, and they could be watching somebody completely different and like what they see from you.
